🎉 Site Launched!

Published July 20, 2026 Kyambogo Student Hub

Welcome to kyu.clareon.live — the student hub for Kyambogo 2026/2027 admitted students. Join the WhatsApp group to connect with fellow students and stay updated on new resources.

The update

Welcome to kyu.clareon.live, a student hub for Kyambogo University students joining the 2026/2027 academic year. We are bringing together study resources, course updates, announcements, and community links in one place. Join the WhatsApp group to connect with fellow students and stay updated as new resources are added.
